about: Performance Gate timing thresholds (scripts/perf-gate/ab-verdict.ts), set from base-vs-base runs on GitHub's ubuntu-24.04 runners (.agents/memory/performance.md). A head is slower or heavier when the median of its paired differences from the base exceeds both the relative and the absolute limit. The gate reads main's copy; a pull request that loosens one needs the perf-regression-accepted label.
